meta.name: data-storytelling
meta.description: Transform data into compelling narratives using visualization, context, and persuasive structure. Use when presenting analytics to stakeholders, creating data reports, or building executive presentations.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把数据变成有说服力的故事
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你常需要向别人解释数据背后的含义
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to explain the meaning behind data to others

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会帮你把数据变成有说服力的故事。它会自动套用叙事结构（如问题-解决方案、趋势对比），生成包含标题、数据、图表建议和行动号召的演示文稿或报告。
howto.when: 当你需要向高管、投资者或非技术团队展示数据分析结果，或撰写数据驱动的报告时触发。

say.text: 帮我用问题-解决方案框架分析客户流失数据。
用趋势故事框架总结Q4业绩，突出关键转折点。
say.note: Claude 会按时间线展示变化，并给出前后对比和关键洞察。

say.text: 对比EMEA和APAC市场机会，给出推荐。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude helps you turn data into compelling narratives. It automatically applies story structures (e.g., problem-solution, trend comparison) to generate presentations or reports with headlines, data, chart suggestions, and calls to action.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to present analytics to executives, investors, or non-technical audiences, or when creating data-driven reports.

say_en.text: Analyze customer churn data using the problem-solution framework.
Summarize Q4 performance with a trend story, highlighting key turning points.
say_en.note: Claude shows changes over time with before/after comparisons and key insights.

say_en.text: Compare EMEA and APAC market opportunities and give a recommendation.
